title: Word-only confirmation codes from a transcription-safe wordlist
description: Moonshine normalizes spoken numbers ('blue seven' became '27'), so voice confirmation codes are two words from a curated list (e.g. 'maple falcon'), added to key terms while the request is open, compared normalized, with an attempt limit that tolerates mishearing. Gherkin first. See docs/VOICE.md, Spike results > Test 4, and Design > 3a.
